Each website you want to target will need its own config. There are plenty available online but they often don't work and are outdated. Follow flavoral's guide, you will be able to create your own configs.

[b][color=white]Dubai Government Entity Accepts Crypto Payments[/color][/b]
The government-owned free trade zone and licensing entity KIKLABB are looking to accept cryptocurrency payments from clients. They are able to issue onshore licenses that are by the book and governed by the regulations of the Trakhees Authority. Trakhees is the regulatory division of the Ports, Customs, and Free Zone Corporation; they handle regulating and licensing businesses in special development areas. In addition to paying for trade licenses, clients are able to lease office space aboard the Queen Elizabeth 2 (QE2) ocean liner. KIKLABB intends to accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether (USDT) as payment methods. While BTC and ETH can be highly volatile, USDT is a stablecoin and is supposed to be pegged to the United States Dollar.  This can add some security for clients wishing to use cryptocurrencies while paying with a stable option. The entity stated that "customers can register as well as pay for Dubai trade licenses remotely and with a virtual currency, using just their smartphone." They are eliminating the need for face-to-face meetings with cash and credit cards and instead allow customers to turn to an online world where people can manage their trade license anywhere and everywhere with their digital currencies. [i][size=x-small][url=https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/dubai-free-zone-kiklabb-starts-accepting-bitcoin---first-government-entity-to-do-so-1.1613463760910]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]

[b][color=white]Nvidia Intentionally Reduces GPU Mining Ability[/color][/b]
The graphics card manufacturer Nvidia has intentionally imposed limitations on their new cards in an effort to reduce the demand for their GPUs. There has been an issue with stocking the new RTX cards and, well, that is thanks to cryptocurrency miners. Ethereum is one of the most popular cryptocurrencies and many miners opt for the latest and greatest cards to improve their mining rigs. In order to prevent shortages, the company is reducing the efficiency of mining Ethereum on its latest card by 50%. This move is to ensure that the company's products "end up in the hands of gamers" instead of miners that are looking to create mini mining farms. So far, this will only affect the RTX 3060 through the card's software. [i][size=x-small][url=https://www.engadget.com/nvidia-limits-rtx-3060-for-crypto-mining-161657361.html]>>Source[/url][/size][/i]
